items.title: Local Gradient Neural Operator: Learning Local, Interpretable, and Lightweight Operators for PDEs
items.excerpt: LGNO replaces global spectral mixing with local stencil-like kernels derived from nonlinear gradient discretization. The authors evaluate diffusion, flow and quantum PDEs, positioning the operator as a lightweight and more interpretable alternative for scientific surrogate modeling.
items.query: neural operator PDE engineering September 2026 local interpretable

items.title: AI and TCAD for Inverse Design and Defect Discovery
items.excerpt: The work combines TCAD-generated data with machine learning for inverse design, defect discovery, contact-resistance prediction, FinFET I-V/C-V modeling and TCAD parameter calibration, and also explores LLM assistance for command-file workflows.
items.query: AI TCAD inverse design defect discovery September 2026

items.title: InstructMesh: Instruction-Driven Repair of Generated 3D Meshes
items.category: AIによる設計・生成設計
items.excerpt: InstructMesh lets users select regions of a generated 3D mesh and apply bounded repair operations through natural language or sliders. The system targets local correction of geometry rather than regenerating an entire asset and includes user studies and physical-fabrication examples.
items.query: generative design 3D mesh repair natural language August September 2026

items.title: Modernizing legacy Fortran with AI agents
items.category: AIエージェント・コーディング
items.excerpt: Mistral describes an agentic modernization project for a European energy operator involving roughly 40,000 lines of Fortran 77 migrated toward C++. The case emphasizes architectural refactoring and verification rather than syntax-only code translation.
items.query: Mistral legacy Fortran modernization agent September 9 2026

items.title: Samsung and Mistral AI announce strategic partnership for intelligence-driven semiconductor infrastructure
items.excerpt: Samsung and Mistral AI announced a partnership to deploy customized, on-premises AI models across semiconductor operations. The companies say the work will target chip engineering and manufacturing workflows while keeping sensitive operational data under enterprise control.
items.query: Samsung Mistral semiconductor AI engineering manufacturing September 9 2026

items.title: EdgeCortix signs multi-year agreement with Kawasaki Heavy Industries for edge AI systems
items.excerpt: EdgeCortix and Kawasaki Heavy Industries announced a 2026–2028 agreement worth several million dollars covering development, feasibility studies, system integration and prototypes using EdgeCortix chiplet AI technology and the MERA software stack for stringent power, latency and reliability requirements.
items.query: Kawasaki Heavy Industries EdgeCortix edge AI aerospace September 2026

items.title: Hitachi Construction Machinery starts physical-AI R&D for autonomous excavator operation
items.category: Physical AI・製造/建機・日本
items.excerpt: Hitachi Construction Machinery says it will begin physical-AI R&D in October under METI/NEDO GENIAC, training on operator lever actions, camera data and work instructions so AI can determine and execute excavator operations. The announcement frames the work as field-level embodied automation.
items.query: Japan physical AI industrial equipment GENIAC September 9 2026

items.title: Evolvable Operational Digital Twin Architecture for Real-Time Field-Level Control of Distributed Manufacturing Systems
items.excerpt: The paper proposes an evolvable operational digital-twin architecture for distributed, adaptable and self-organizing manufacturing systems. Use cases include dynamic fault handling and task scheduling with live twins, while the authors identify hard real-time behavior and reliability as implementation challenges.
items.query: operational digital twin manufacturing real-time September 2026

items.title: Introducing CUDA Rust: Two tracks for writing GPU kernels
items.excerpt: NVIDIA introduced cuda-oxide, an early-alpha custom rustc backend that emits PTX, and cutile-rs, a stable-Rust tile-programming path using CUDA Tile IR and JIT compilation. The post positions Rust memory-safety mechanisms as useful for GPU software while retaining low-level kernel control.
items.query: CUDA Rust GPU kernels September 2026 NVIDIA

items.title: HP extends data-center AI architecture to the edge
items.excerpt: HP announced a planned edge-AI platform with Red Hat and NVIDIA, including a ZGX Fury system using the NVIDIA GB300 Grace Blackwell Ultra Desktop Superchip and Red Hat AI software. HP positions the stack for sandboxed evaluation before production and locally governed inference.
items.query: edge AI platform GB300 Red Hat NVIDIA September 2026

items.title: Red Hat AI 3.5 expands governance, evaluation and observability for production agents
items.excerpt: Red Hat AI 3.5 adds EvalHub safety benchmarking, agent and inference observability, GPU/token showback, hosted control planes, multitenancy and agent templates. Red Hat says the release includes more than 20 validated models with published safety scores.
items.query: Red Hat AI 3.5 agents evaluation governance September 9 2026

items.title: Backblaze introduces an open-source B2 MCP Server
items.excerpt: Backblaze released an open-source MCP server exposing up to 40 B2 storage tools. The tool surface follows scoped B2 application-key permissions, supports short-lived URLs, and can require confirmation or block destructive operations; hosted HTTP mode blocks destructive calls by default.
items.query: Backblaze B2 MCP server September 2026

items.title: F5 announces Workforce AI Security for governing employee-facing AI agents
items.category: AIエージェント・安全性
items.excerpt: F5 announced an agentless security offering intended to give policy control and visibility across workforce AI, including actions agents take on users' behalf. F5 highlights assistants and coding agents that can access systems, call tools and manipulate data using delegated permissions.
items.query: workforce AI agent security permissions September 9 2026

items.title: Nightfall launches MCP Gateway to govern AI agents before tool execution
items.category: AIエージェント・MCP・安全性
items.excerpt: Nightfall's MCP Gateway is a governed proxy that intercepts and enforces agent tool calls before execution. The company describes per-tenant encrypted credential brokering and policies that can block high-risk actions such as deletes or database drops across several coding-agent and desktop surfaces.
items.query: MCP gateway agent tool governance September 9 2026

items.title: Zscaler launches Agentic SOC for AI-assisted security operations
items.category: AIエージェント・セキュリティ
items.excerpt: Zscaler announced an AI-first SOC architecture combining exposure management and security operations with specialized agents for detection, investigation and response. The release is a product-direction signal for governed agentic workflows in a high-consequence operational domain.
items.query: agentic SOC AI security operations September 9 2026

items.title: Cymphony launches with $30 million to secure AI-agent access to enterprise data
items.category: AIエージェント・Identity/安全性
items.excerpt: Cymphony launched with $30 million in funding to build security and governance controls for human and AI-agent access to sensitive enterprise data and systems. The financing was co-led by Sequoia Capital and SMBC Fin Atlas Beyond.
items.query: AI agent access security startup funding September 9 2026

items.title: How we built Agent Memory: goals, architecture, and engineering decisions
items.excerpt: WRITER describes the architecture of Agent Memory as a team-level memory layer built around work tasks, requirements, deliverables and organizational knowledge rather than isolated chat history. The design emphasizes transparent, traceable shared context for enterprise agents.
items.query: enterprise agent memory architecture September 9 2026

items.title: UiPath AI Adoption & Orchestration Survey 2026
items.excerpt: UiPath surveyed 590 C-suite and IT leaders at $1B+ organizations across six countries from May 25 to June 8. It reports 31% have AI fully embedded, 29% have orchestration fully embedded, and among the latter group 89% say agentic implementations met or exceeded ROI expectations.
items.query: AI adoption orchestration ROI survey September 9 2026

items.title: Camunda research finds process gaps behind failed AI initiatives
items.excerpt: Camunda reports 72% of surveyed organizations say process-related challenges have caused AI initiatives to fail and estimates an average cost of $1.55 million per business. The report also says 82% expect AI investments to fail without more process redesign.
items.query: AI process redesign failure survey September 9 2026

items.title: Akeneo survey says AI-commerce ambition is outpacing product-data foundations
items.excerpt: Akeneo surveyed 1,000 senior IT decision-makers in the US and Europe. The company reports 95% are confident they are ready for AI-driven commerce and 87% expect budgets to rise over one to two years, while product-data quality, integration and governance remain core dependencies.
items.query: enterprise AI data readiness survey September 9 2026

items.title: Clarivate Pulse of the Library 2026 shows large geographic gaps in AI adoption
items.excerpt: Clarivate's global library survey, run with Library Journal and external analysis, reports moderate-to-active AI adoption at 28% in mainland China versus 16% globally. It also reports 51% joint library-and-IT governance in active Chinese implementations versus 26% overall.
items.query: global AI adoption survey China September 9 2026 governance

items.title: Thermal conductivity predictions with foundation atomistic models
items.excerpt: The study evaluates foundation atomistic models against thermal-transport and thermal-expansion calculations for a database of 103 solids. It links force/energy accuracy to downstream thermal properties and proposes fine-tuning protocols, emphasizing physics-aware validation of atomistic foundation models.
items.query: foundation atomistic model thermal conductivity materials September 2026

items.title: AI reveals a new cellular switch linked to cancer pathways
items.excerpt: Cornell researchers used AlphaFold to search for previously unknown Arf1 interaction partners, then validated Avl9 experimentally as an off-switch. The team reports a single-amino-acid mutation eliminated the effect and that disrupting the pathway reduced lung-cancer-cell movement.
items.query: AlphaFold scientific discovery September 9 2026 experimental validation

items.title: Analog Devices to acquire Alif Semiconductor for edge AI and physical intelligence
items.excerpt: Analog Devices agreed to acquire Alif Semiconductor for $1.35 billion in cash plus up to $200 million contingent consideration. Alif develops AI-native fusion processors and edge-AI microcontrollers for real-time sensor fusion and low-latency on-device inference.
items.query: edge AI semiconductor acquisition September 9 2026 physical intelligence

items.title: Backblaze and WEKA simplify data management across the AI lifecycle
items.excerpt: Backblaze and WEKA announced a validated architecture that keeps performance-sensitive AI workloads on WEKA while moving large datasets, checkpoints and outputs to Backblaze B2. The release positions tiering and lifecycle placement as a cost/performance control for AI data pipelines.
items.query: AI data lifecycle storage checkpoint WEKA Backblaze September 9 2026

items.title: NeoMME: a multimodal-native multilingual encoder for retrieval
items.excerpt: NeoMME is a multimodal-native multilingual encoder that handles text and images in one Transformer and exposes dense and late-interaction retrieval heads. The release targets visual and multilingual RAG, including high-resolution document retrieval.
items.query: open model multimodal retriever RAG September 2026
